notes: NBIM: the quote is this company's equity row in NBIM's holdings data file at June 30, 2026 ("o" = ownership %, "eq.v" = voting %, "a.e" = market value in USD, "a.n" = in NOK). CalPERS: the source is the information table of CalPERS's Form 13F for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Form 13F covers only U.S.-listed securities, and the quoted row gives issuer, class, CUSIP, value in dollars and shares. CalPERS holds the listed Class B; the denominator is Class A plus Class B from the Q1 fiscal 2027 10-Q cover at September 28, 2026, the same count used in the marketcap lens. Holders of record: listed Class B only, stated as approximately 20,000; Class A has 16 holders of record.
